cases.note: §8.1 publishes this preimage in full, which pins the field order and both length prefixes.

chunk_signing.signature_encoding: secp256k1 direct over the 32-byte digest, RFC6979 deterministic, compact raw64 R||S with low-S

mutation_digests.note: same value as the accepted STOP_SEQUENCE case; included explicitly as the finish_reason mutation

rejected_finish_reason_values.reason: unset is not a successful termination

negative.name: chunks_merged
negative.reason: The same concatenated text in three chunks instead of four. Chunk boundaries are committed, so this is a different output_hash.

negative.name: chunks_reordered
negative.reason: index enters the leaf preimage, so swapping two chunks changes the root.

negative.name: empty_output_as_empty_tree
negative.reason: MmrEmptyV1(TRUEOPEN_OUTPUT_MMR_V1). An empty output is one zero-length leaf, so this value is never a legal output_hash.

negative.name: seq_and_root_unpaired
negative.reason: seq 1 signed against root_1 instead of root_2. The pair is committed together, so the digest moves.

negative.name: other_chain_id
negative.reason: A frame signature must not replay onto another chain.

negative.name: task_hash_one_bit_flipped
negative.reason: A frame signature must not replay onto another task.

notes: output_hash is the MMR root of the ordered TEXT component chunks under TRUEOPEN_OUTPUT_MMR_V1, not a hash of the concatenated text. The two differ even at one chunk, so an implementation must not keep a whole-blob path for the single-chunk case.

Chunk boundaries are part of the commitment: re-chunking the same bytes changes output_hash. negative[] carries the merged and the reordered value, so an implementation that normalises boundaries fails here instead of at integration time.
An empty output is one zero-length leaf with output_leaf_count 1, not an empty tree. empty_output.empty_tree_root_hex is the value that must never appear as an output_hash.
prefix_roots_hex[k-1] is the root of the first k chunks, which is what the Worker signs at seq = k-1. Holding frame k is holding the Worker's commitment to the whole prefix.
TRUEOPEN_OUTPUT_CHUNK_V1 is H_FIELDS_V1 over exactly four fields in this order: chain_id, task_hash, seq, mmr_root. seq is u64_be and mmr_root is raw32, never hex text.

TRUEOPEN_OUTPUT_FIN_V1 is H_FIELDS_V1 over exactly five fields in this order: chain_id, task_hash, final_seq, output_mmr_root, finish_reason. final_seq is u64_be, output_mmr_root is raw32 and the FinishReasonV1 enum number is uint32_be.
OutputFinV1 is successful termination only. FinishReasonV1 values 1 through 4 are accepted; UNSPECIFIED, unknown values, failures and cancellations are rejected before digest verification.

output_leaf_count is an InferReceipt field and enters neither digest. The root alone does not fix the tree shape, so a prefix contradiction proof takes the leaf count from chain state rather than from the submitter.
Both domains activate with TRUEOPEN_INFER_RECEIPT_V2; before that batch no party's material under them is accepted.
source: §8.1 publishes these vectors byte for byte and registers the two domains. The tree primitive itself is shared/mmr_primitive_v1.json (00-fundamentals §9 and §11.5). Authored in this repository because streaming OUTPUT delivery introduced both domains and no chain type carries them until TRUEOPEN_INFER_RECEIPT_V2.
